g.title: Common
g.text: Heavy blue: cascade-delete | Thin orange: weak | Gray: stored data
Open triangle: one slot (may be null) | Filled triangle: many | Arrows: parent / holder → child / value

a.xlink:title: Agent.children → Agent; strong; many; reverse: Agent.agentParent; Child Agents are also owned by Ensemble; this is not a tree.
Agent.workProductTransfers → Agent.WorkProductTransfer; strong; many; reverse: Agent.WorkProductTransfer.parent; Close admission, cancel, join transfers; remove back-references on completion.
Agent.outgoingQuestions → AgentQuestion; strong; many; reverse: AgentQuestion.sender; Either endpoint closes the question; both memberships detach.
Agent.incomingQuestions → AgentQuestion; strong; many; reverse: AgentQuestion.recipient; Either endpoint closes the question; both memberships detach.
Agent.engine → Engine; strong; one slot; reverse: Engine.parent
Agent.history → History; strong; one slot; reverse: History.parent
Agent.jobs → Jobs; strong; one slot; reverse: Jobs.parent
Agent.mcp → Mcp; strong; one slot; reverse: Mcp.parent

Agent.tools → Tool; strong; many; reverse: Tool.parent

Credentials.modelBindings → ModelAuthentication; weak; many; reverse: ModelAuthentication.planCredentials
Engine.cacheLens → CacheLens; strong; one slot; reverse: CacheLens.parent
Ensemble.agents → Agent; strong; many; reverse: Agent.parent

Jobs.children → Job; strong; many; reverse: Job.parent
Mcp.browser → McpBrowser; strong; one slot; reverse: McpBrowser.parent
Mcp.clients → McpClient; strong; many; reverse: McpClient.parent
McpBrowser.transport → IMcpTransport; strong; one slot; Before claim the registration disposes transport; after claim it destroys its client instead.
McpBrowser.client → McpClient; strong; one slot; reverse: McpClient.browserOwner
McpClient.transport → IMcpTransport; strong; one slot; Owned external I/O boundary: disposal, not a modeled parent back-reference.
McpClient.tools → Tool; strong; many; reverse: Tool.remote
McpProcessTransport.wire → McpStreamTransport; strong; one slot; Owned transport implementation; no model parent back-reference.
Model.agents → Agent; weak; many; reverse: Agent.selectedModel; Removing the model detaches selections; it does not destroy Agents.
ModelAuthentication.endpoints → ModelEndpoint; weak; many; reverse: ModelEndpoint.authentication
ModelEndpoint.models → Model; strong; many; reverse: Model.parent
ModelVendor.endpoints → ModelEndpoint; strong; many; reverse: ModelEndpoint.parent
Skills.clients → McpClient; strong; many; reverse: McpClient.skillOwner
